scope: Calibration-only paired flank Kv1p5 interventions at fixed 0.9x junction permeability in one synthetic tissue.
purpose: Measure paired flank-specific channel effects after uniform remote-channel changes failed the separation objective.

reader.calibration: Unchanged three-strength polyline per arm, panel and timestep; all location/order combinations calibrated. Evaluation strengths never fit curves. The wire key timing now means source order.
reader.features: Every primary panel contains exactly 15 area-weighted voltages from unstimulated cells 2,3,5,6,7, in time-first order. All-cell comparators contain 21 values and never enter primary calibration.
reader.prediction: Project each observed vector onto each adjacent calibration segment with its coordinate clipped to [0,1]. For each task, take the minimum distance among curves with label 0 and label 1. Score=(distance_0-distance_1)/2; positive predicts 1, otherwise 0. Prediction accepts features only: no evaluation strength, labels, IDs or paired counterpart.
reader.margin: Resolved only when abs(score) exceeds the declared margin. Half the distance gap is in feature units and is 1-Lipschitz for fixed curves; it is not a biological noise model or a guarantee of correct generalization. Distances and inferred segment coordinates are retained.
reader.shuffles: Permute whole curve label pairs with the fixed seeds after fitting vertices. This preserves each physical response curve and the balanced label set. Duplicate permutations and the identity are retained; no significance claim.

primary: Calibration geometry on selected320: minimum opposite-label curve half-distance across tasks, active arms and all three timesteps. Condition-calibrated geometry selects a candidate; raw frozen-source and shared-reference-assisted readings of calibration points are separate diagnostics, never fresh confirmation.
panel: Five conditions (sham, cells 2/6 channels 0.9x and 1.1x, cells 3/5 channels 0.9x and 1.1x), three calibration strengths, five arms and four label combinations at three timesteps. No held-out responses are loaded or simulated.

contrast.definition: Label 1 minus label 0 area-weighted voltage, paired at fixed arm, other label and cue strength; 15 unstimulated-cell features in each predeclared observation panel
contrast.criteria_rationale: The absolute stability limit uses the original synthetic reader margin; the signal floor is twice that margin. The 10% limit requires small relative change as well. These are declared numerical diagnostics, not measured sensor precision or a continuum error bound.
contrast.stable_at_finest_steps: The 0.125-to-0.0625-us contrast change must satisfy BOTH the inherited 2-nV absolute and 10% relative limits. Separately report the signal floor and whether the 0.25-us contrast meets the same limits against 0.0625 us.
contrast.order_resolution: For each coordinate, a difference of two paired contrasts uses four inherited voltage comparison allowances: 4*atol + 2*rtol*(max_abs_early + max_abs_late). The two successive L2 changes must each exceed five times its L2 norm before interpreting their ratio as resolved first-order refinement. This comparison allowance is not a statistical noise estimate.

contrasts: For both labels, pair opposite labels at fixed arm, strength and other label. Report all pairs, including redundant single-task controls; they are not independent samples. Compare all three timestep contrasts using the inherited thresholds.
historical_reproduction: Sham full histories reproduce the completed uniform-channel sham bitwise. Changed-flank candidates reproduce initial states only, including no-cue and disconnected arms.
storage: Write complete 14-array state histories and sampled fields per world/window; retain only the current batch window and compact readout vectors. Compare CPU/L4 and changed-window replay by reading archive segments. Per-world inputs and completed windows remain durable on failure.
scope_exclusions: Calibration-only intervention design for one synthetic tissue. No local rescue, biological replication, whole-organ validation, new BETSE/BITSEY parity or multi-GPU scaling result.
Each probe changes two cells together. It measures that group intervention, not independent single-cell derivatives or a general spatial controller.
Present from initialization; not a post-damage recovery or adaptive controller.
Source channel availability, fractional cue inhibition and timing stay fixed. Network feedback may change ionic currents and transported charge.
The two flank groups have slightly different membrane areas. Equal relative permeability changes are not equal absolute channel-capacity changes; report each area-weighted change.
Retain raw frozen-source, shared-no-cue-reference-assisted and condition-calibrated views separately. A geometric gain does not establish raw transfer.
Freeze any selected candidate before a separate fresh-strength experiment. No held-out responses enter this pilot.
Same synthetic initial state and calibration cases. Sham/backend/timestep repetitions are numerical controls, not independent biological cases.
A geometry gain alone is not biological recovery or raw-reader transfer. Retain every valid negative result and invalid failure.
Record GPU busy and measured SM-active with coverage and per-arm timing. No automatic polling, retry or follow-up.

cue_timing.selection: Inherited source pulse timing remains fixed in every local-channel condition.
cue_timing.source_allocation: Each source retains amplitude * its 75/25 location share * minimum source membrane area integrated over 8 us. Order-only uses 50/50; no-cue uses zero. Compare dose with the common-pulse encoding at the SAME new strength.
cue_timing.comparison_panels: Only selected320 ranks channel conditions; spanning512 and long512 remain descriptive comparators.

replay.purpose: Resume at 103.9375 us before the shifted second pulse, crossing its 112/120-us events with 257-step windows, reordering and partitioning four calibration worlds.

task_meanings.location: 0: source 1 receives 75% of dose, source 4 receives 25%; 1: reverse allocation.
task_meanings.timing: Internal reader key for source_order: 0 = source 1 early and source 4 late; 1 = source 4 early and source 1 late. This is NOT the preceding common early/late cue task.
task_meanings.timing_only: Internal arm key for order-only: 50/50 source doses with the same opposite pulse orders.

execution_estimate.basis: 900 worlds/backend versus the completed 540-world four-hour uniform-channel pilot; includes CPU then L4 and archive handling.
